_comment: Cards that exist only for the attach-an-Aura-to-a-player test (tests/unit/attachments/test_attach_to_player.py). Never part of a deck list; loaded by the test registry fixture alongside data/cards/. `t_archnemesis` is the Archnemesis prototype, all three sentences; `t_robe_mover` is an 'Enchant player' Aura that moves onto a player who attacks you, where any seat is a legal host.

cards.name: Test Archnemesis
cards.oracle_text:
Enchant opponent
Whenever you attack enchanted player, that player loses 2 life. You draw a card and gain 2 life.
Whenever a player attacks you, you may attach this Aura to that player.
